content.text: The implementation is complete and clean. Let me run one final comprehensive validation round:

arguments.command:
cd /app/work && echo "===== FINAL VALIDATION =====" && \
echo "--- public examples ---" && for ex in ambiguity empty bad-type; do
  (cd /app/submission && ./run.sh < /app/examples/$ex.json > /app/work/tmp/f_$ex.json 2>/dev/null); echo -n "$ex: exit=$? "
  python3 -c "
import json
got=json.load(open('/app/work/tmp/f_$ex.json')); exp=json.load(open('/app/examples/$ex.expected.json'))
def norm(r):
    if 'error' in r: return ('err', r['error'])
    return ('ok', sorted((c['signature'], c['members'], tuple(sorted((l['atom'],l['negated']) for l in c['representative']['or']))) for c in r['classes']),
            [(q['trace'],q['end'],q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']])
print('MATCH' if norm(got)==norm(exp) else 'MISMATCH')
"
done
